'''Pia''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] with fair skin and dark-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She at one point wore hooded yellow [[Robe/Legends|robes]] that resembled the [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|royal]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]].<ref name="Art Visions" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pia was created for the [[2010]] art book, ''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]'', by painter [[Anthony J. Ryder]], who painted her portrait over a period of six months between [[November]] [[2008]] and [[May]] [[2009]]. Even though she was pictured, no back-story was given to her in the book. Ryder used the handmaidens of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] as inspiration for Pia's intended expression of "quiet reserve, presence, compassion, and attraction."<ref name="Art Visions" />
